what: Runner-contract baseline on the accepted afdb-project-cancellation artifact 7313e7fc6972edfc7a8b927ed2d06255301cacd1766c92c87b5defc9125e8c7d (gate 1.5.0, 44/44 checks, exact-byte --accept ACCEPTED in job afdb-build-001), fetched from private staging release 435481585 rather than rebuilt: re-accept the five fetched files against the gate's own collected report BEFORE any score, materialize the runner workdir (public train+eval only; the private holdout is fetched for --accept over the full artifact but never copied into a workdir), run the benchmark's own train.py and validate.sh unmodified, then compute the PRE-REGISTERED deciding check: the full model's per-row eval scores (same code path as validate.py, runner unmodified) vs every triad member (global_rate, trailing_country_rate, trailing_sector_decade_rate) on the identical 1,126 eval rows, cluster-aware paired bootstrap, cluster = declared event_key. Construction-time references on the same rows (job afdb-build-001): trailing_country_rate 0.5491, trailing_sector_decade_rate 0.4697, global_rate degenerate, persistence_country_last 0.5287 (supplementary), majority-class accuracy 0.9716. Headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the model beats EVERY member with a CI excluding zero in its favour; triad dominance -> DROP per the pre-registered rule. Contract only, no agent loop, no holdout score.
stopping_condition: re-accept failure refuses scoring before any number exists; a failed runner contract is a recorded blocker, never rescored ad hoc; the deciding verdict (either direction) is a recorded finding, not a retry trigger - no re-tuning of threshold, window, label or features after any score.
